description: Machine-readable registry for local project skills. Inspired by Project Golem's skill registry concept, but scoped to this Python pipeline.

skills.name: Market Analysis Memory
skills.trigger: Use before generating or evaluating daily market analysis.
skills.output_contract: Prior prediction context, concrete institutional behavior, valid/low-sample YouTube learning rules.

skills.name: YouTube Title Packaging
skills.trigger: Use when generating two YouTube title candidates or evaluating title performance.
skills.output_contract: Exactly two title candidates, A/B evaluation threshold, high-weight formulas.

skills.name: Thumbnail A/B Testing
skills.trigger: Use when building thumbnail prompts or deciding whether to replace a thumbnail.
skills.output_contract: Two visually distinct thumbnail concepts with exact visible text and 900-view sample rule.

skills.name: NotebookLM Cover Alignment
skills.trigger: Use when preparing NotebookLM source material or aligning first-slide cover guidance.
skills.output_contract: Cover-first instruction with title lines, date label, and visual theme alignment.
